title: 第19章 做了个噩梦
novel_title: 丰腴小村妇，大佬们跪求嫁给他(锦绣钱澄)
content_zh: 他上来并不着急办事。先给她揉了揉小腿。两人一句话都没有交流，但彼此间的肢体互动，似乎已经习以为常了。他动作娴熟地给她按完小腿，又按大腿。最后，给她脊柱都给推了一遍。舒服！感觉自己日常的含胸，都给按板直了。她想问，你一个大老粗，什么时候学的这些？可是她知道，傻叔一个字都不会回答。所以干脆就这样，默默接受他的推拿，疏通筋骨。隔壁张国海趴着墙缝，觉得今晚床动有些不对劲。看姿势，也不对。怎么像在按摩？连续办了五天事，这是不行了？看来，壮汉也不是力气用不完的嘛！今天去赶趟圩，回来就真虚了！嗤！他心里总算平衡了一点。范金花也纳闷，今晚动静实在怪异。可别休假了哟！那人说，连续七天，不成包退钱。他要是就办五六天，万一就因为差这一两天，就不成事，可怎么办？这么一想，她就有些着急。可是又不能开口提醒，只能跟张国海一样，趴着墙干着急。别说老两口着急，徐喜弟也着急。自己身上每一块骨头都给他捏松了，都开始昏昏欲睡了。他怎么还不动？两人的衣服，一件都还没脱。难道要她开口邀请，他才肯？是不是太羞人了。可是，再晚一点的话，按照他的时间，怕不是要忙到天亮？那可就太不好看了呀！趴着的徐喜弟，总算克服了自己的睡意。要不给对方一个暗示吧。于是她的右手，往身后一掏。……嘶～他吸了一口冷气。本来念在她今天赶圩跑了一天路，太累，想让她休息一晚的。刚刚给她松了差不多一小时的筋骨，还以为睡着了呢。结果还在巴巴等着？那他怎么能辜负她的美意？当然不能了！终于，徐喜弟没能翻身，就那样软软地趴着。……笃，笃，笃。像是沉重的敲门声。张国海立刻就来了精神。他扒拉那个板缝，却没有看到昨夜那样的晃动身影。一边的范金花总算放心了。过了今晚，还有最后一晚，之后就只管等好消息。可黑暗里，听着敲墙声，她心里也很难按捺。或许是自己好日子刚走，那点念想给挑起来了？……徐喜弟抱着枕头，包着自己的脸，咬牙忍了好一阵。最后还是没能忍住，闷闷地哼着声。还能这样！一直哼到了大深夜。最后都脱力了，叠着休息好一阵，才总算缓过来。像被抽了筋一般，艰难分开。太累了。徐喜弟几乎秒入了梦。梦里她大着肚子，躺在床上拼着老命用力生。费了九牛二虎之力，总算呱呱坠地。是个儿子。然后，他闭着眼睛就连干了三碗奶！妈耶！生了个饭桶！徐喜弟吓得惊坐起！才发现天已经亮了。这次起床，没有前几天那么费劲。她甚至感觉身子很轻快，全身通畅。或许是因为傻叔昨夜给她捏了筋骨的关系？……起床的第一件事，就是找巴儿姐。她已经早早坐在堂屋，吃她昨天在街上买的东西。这个心性，想让她嫁人？难！……吃过早饭，徐喜弟就拉着巴儿姐，捡一家人的脏衣服，准备去溪边洗。“妈，你们屋里还有要洗的，一起给我吧。”她朝正在煮猪食的范金花说道。平时，她从不进公婆房间，偶尔家里衣服大清洗，也是让公婆拿出来。“该洗的，我都拿出来了。”范金花头也不抬。张国海一听，转身去屋里，卷了床单出来。“这个也拿去洗洗！”说着，床单已经塞在桶里。一家人的衣服，弄了整整两桶，正好一担子。徐喜弟拍拍巴儿姐的肩膀，又指了指挑担。巴儿姐鼓着嘴，就挑起来出门。溪边已经有几个老婶子，在热闹地聊着什么。看到徐喜弟和巴儿姐挑着衣服担子过来，立马收了嘴。她们从前也这样，徐喜弟习惯了。可是今天她们的眼神有点嫌恶。说不清道不明，直勾勾在她和巴儿姐身上来回瞧。徐喜弟皱了皱眉，早知道先看看溪边，没人再来。可是人已经到溪边了，巴儿姐倒是啥事没有，把衣服往旁边一倒，就蹲下来。随手拿一件衣服，就往水里铺，等浸透了水，看起来撒一点洗衣粉，抡起板锤就砰砰捶。没办法，徐喜弟也只好硬着头皮，在她旁边蹲下来开始洗。咚！忽然有个石子，被人从身后扔进水里。正好落在她们面前，溅起一点小水花，落在巴儿姐的脸上。巴儿姐生气地转头，看到两个一大一小的男娃子，站在她们身后不远处。“阿巴阿巴……巴巴……”这两个男娃子，平日就没少捉弄她，今天直接当着这么多人的面，就往水里丢石头。两人也听不懂巴儿姐在咒骂什么，又丢了两颗石子。咚~咚~巴儿姐抡起板锤，起身就追了上去。唉！徐喜弟慌忙跟过去，两个娃子不过八九岁，十一二岁的样子，真让巴儿姐抓住，下手没轻没重，可不是闹着玩的。跑出去十来步，溪边又开始嬉闹起来。徐喜弟一个回头，她们就压低了声，交头接耳，啧啧声简直震耳欲聋。究竟怎么回事？今天太奇怪了！再看巴儿姐，已经追着两个捣蛋鬼跑进村，钻进了小道。她只能咬咬牙，加快脚步。“喜弟，你跑啥呢？”刘宇宁正在给家里的猪圈修围栏，看到徐喜弟从院前飘过，追出来问。“我追巴儿姐呢，她拿着板锤，追那俩猴，我怕出事。”徐喜弟一边跑一边应，头都没敢回。刘宇宁远远看了一眼，也吓一跳，他跑得快，他追比较靠谱。于是，一个身影从徐喜弟身旁，嗖一声飞了过去。追到离巴儿姐他们几步远，他耳朵里听到一句顺口溜。“看五毛，么五块，做要五十块……”两个捣蛋鬼，边跑边哼。刘宇宁咬咬牙，加了两匹马力，很快就把两人拽住。巴儿姐见人被抓住，抡起板锤就想往他们脸上崩。刘宇宁大声呵止。
content_en: He came up in no hurry to do anything.First he rubbed her calves.The two of them didn't exchange a word, but their physical interactions seemed to be something they were used to.He massaged her calves and thighs skillfully.Finally, I pushed her spine.Comfortable!I feel like my daily routine of holding my breasts is straightened.She wanted to ask, you are such a rough guy, when did you learn this?But she knew that Uncle Silly wouldn't answer a word.So I just let him do it, silently accepting his massage to clear my muscles and bones.Next door, Zhang Guohai was lying on the crack of the wall, feeling that something was wrong with the movement of the bed tonight.Judging from the posture, it's not right either.How does it feel like a massage?I've been doing errands for five days in a row. Is this no longer possible?It seems that a strong man is not inexhaustible!I went to catch a trip to Wei today, but I felt really empty when I came back!laugh!He finally felt a little more balanced.Fan Jinhua was also puzzled. The movement tonight was really weird.Don’t take a vacation!The man said that no refund would be given for seven consecutive days.If he only takes five or six days to do it, what if it fails just because of a delay of one or two days?Thinking of this, she became a little anxious.But he couldn't remind him, so he could only lie on the wall and worry like Zhang Guohai.Not to mention the old couple being anxious, Xu Xidi was also anxious.Every bone in his body was loosened by him, and he began to feel drowsy.Why doesn't he move?Neither of them had taken off any of their clothes.Does he have to ask her to invite her before he agrees?Isn't it too embarrassing?However, if it were later, according to his time, he might be busy until dawn?That would be too ugly!Xu Xidi, who was lying on his stomach, finally overcame his sleepiness.How about giving the other party a hint.So she reached behind her with her right hand....Hiss~ He took a breath of air.Originally, I wanted her to rest for the night because she was too tired after running around for a long time.I had just relaxed her muscles and bones for almost an hour, and she thought she had fallen asleep.Are you still waiting for the result?Then how could he live up to her kindness?Of course not!Finally, Xu Xidi failed to turn over and just lay there softly....Tuk, Tuk, Tuk.Like a heavy knock on the door.Zhang Guohai immediately became energetic.He pulled at the crack in the board, but did not see the shaking figure like last night.Fan Jinhua on the side was finally relieved.After tonight, and the last night, just wait for the good news.But in the darkness, listening to the knocking on the wall, it was hard for her to restrain herself.Maybe it's because my good days have just left, and those thoughts have stirred up?...Xu Xidi hugged the pillow and wrapped his face, gritting his teeth and enduring it for a while.In the end, he couldn't hold it back anymore and hummed muffledly.It can still be like this!I kept humming until late at night.In the end, I lost all my strength. I rested for a while and finally recovered.As if being cramped, it was difficult to separate.So tired.Xu Xidi fell asleep almost instantly.In the dream, she had a pregnant belly and was lying on the bed trying her best to give birth.After a lot of effort, he was finally born.It's a son.Then, with his eyes closed, he fucked three bowls of milk!Oh my god!A mess was born!Xu Xidi sat up in shock!Only then did I realize that it was already dawn.Getting up this time was not as strenuous as the previous few days.She even felt very light and smooth all over.Maybe it's because Uncle Silly pinched her bones last night?...The first thing I do when I get up is to look for Sister Baer.She was already sitting in the main room early, eating what she bought on the street yesterday.With this character, do you want her to get married?Disaster!...After breakfast, Xu Xidi took Sister Ba'er to pick up the family's dirty clothes and prepared to wash them by the stream."Mom, you still have something to wash in the house. Give it to me." She said to Fan Jinhua who was cooking pig food.Normally, she never enters her parents-in-law's room. Occasionally, she would ask her parents-in-law to take out the clothes when the house was cleaned."I took out everything that should be washed." Fan Jinhua didn't even raise his head.Upon hearing this, Zhang Guohai turned around and went into the room, rolled up the sheets and came out."Take this and wash it too!" As he said, the sheets were already stuffed in the bucket.There were two full buckets of clothes for the whole family, which was exactly one load.Xu Xidi patted Sister Ba'er on the shoulder and pointed at the burden.Sister Ba'er puffed her lips and picked it up to go out.There were already several old ladies by the stream, chatting lively about something.Seeing Xu Xidi and Sister Ba'er carrying clothes and burdens, they immediately stopped talking.They had been like this before, and Xu Xidi was used to it.But today they looked a little disgusted.He couldn't explain it clearly, he looked back and forth between her and Sister Ba'er.Xu Xidi frowned. He had known that he would look at the stream first and no one would come.But the people had already reached the stream, and Sister Ba'er was fine. She threw her clothes aside and squatted down.Pick up a piece of clothing, put it in the water, wait until it is soaked in water, sprinkle a little washing powder on it, then pick up the hammer and bang it.There was no other way, so Xu Xidi had no choice but to bite the bullet, squat down next to her and start washing.Boom!Suddenly a stone was thrown into the water from behind.It landed right in front of them, causing a little splash of water to fall on Sister Ba'er's face.Sister Ba'er turned her head angrily and saw two boys, one big and one small, standing not far behind them."Abba, Abba... Baba..." These two boys often teased her, and today they threw stones into the water in front of so many people.Neither of them could understand what Sister Ba'er was cursing, so they threw two more stones.Dong~dong~ Sister Ba'er swung the hammer, got up and chased after her.well!Xu Xidi hurriedly followed them. The two children were only eight or nine years old, but they looked eleven or twelve years old. Sister Ba'er really caught them. They were neither gentle nor heavy. It was no joke.After running about ten steps, the stream started to play again.As soon as Xu Xidi turned around, they lowered their voices and whispered to each other. The sound was deafening.What's going on?Today is so weird!Looking at Sister Ba'er again, she had already chased two troublemakers into the village and into the path.She could only grit her teeth and speed up her pace."Xidi, why are you running?" Liu Yuning was repairing the fence for the pig pen at home. He saw Xu Xidi floating past the yard and chased him out."I'm chasing Sister Ba'er. She's chasing those two monkeys with a hammer. I'm afraid something will happen." Xu Xidi responded while running, not daring to look back.Liu Yuning took a look from a distance and was startled. He ran fast, so he was more reliable in catching up.Then, a figure flew past Xu Xidi with a whoosh.After chasing them a few steps away from Sister Ba'er and the others, he heard a jingle in his ears."Look at fifty cents, five yuan for that, fifty yuan for making..." The two troublemakers hummed as they ran.Liu Yuning gritted his teeth, added two more horsepower, and quickly grabbed the two of them.When Sister Ba'er saw someone being caught, she picked up a hammer and tried to smash it into their faces.Liu Yuning stopped loudly.
